name: mcp-selfhost
description: Private local Desktop Commander MCP plugin for this Windows development machine.

interface.shortDescription: Use the private local Desktop Commander MCP from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to the self-hosted Desktop Commander bridge on this PC without using the third-party Remote Desktop Commander relay.
